sloka: पुत्रौ दशरथस्य इमौ क्षत्रियौ लोक विश्रुतौ ।द्रष्टु कामौ धनुः श्रेष्ठम् यत् एतत् त्वयि तिष्ठति ॥१-६६-५॥
transliteration: putrau daśarathasya imau kṣatriyau loka viśrutau ।draṣṭu kāmau dhanuḥ śreṣṭham yat etat tvayi tiṣṭhati ॥1-66-5॥

translations.english: Dasaratha's sons, (Rama and Lakshmana), kshatriyas renowned in the world are eager to see that great bow in your possession.
